questions.question:
Which of the ratio is the smallest?

(4)/(5), (12)/(14), (21)/(23), (16)/(19), (79)/(85) = ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratios to compare:

(4)/(5), (12)/(14), (21)/(23), (16)/(19), (79)/(85) 

**Formula Used:**

To compare ratios, we convert them to decimal form.

**Calculations:**

Convert each ratio to decimal form:

(4)/(5) = 0.8

(12)/(14) = 0.857

(21)/(23) = 0.913

(16)/(19) = 0.842

(79)/(85) = 0.929

Comparing these decimals, the smallest ratio is 0.8.

**The smallest ratio is (4)/(5).**

questions.question: What is the result of the expression 4.5 × 2.8 + 3.6 × 2.5 - 1.7 × 12 ? (Use decimal upto 1 point)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Expression: 4.5 × 2.8 + 3.6 × 2.5 - 1.7 × 12

**Formula Used:**

Use the order of operations (BODMAS/BIDMAS):

1. Brackets

2. Orders (i.e. powers and square roots, etc.)

3. Division and Multiplication (left to right)

4. Addition and Subtraction (left to right)

**Calculation:**

4.5 × 2.8 + 3.6 × 2.5 - 1.7 × 12

⇒ 12.6 + 9.0 - 20.4

⇒ 21.6 - 20.4

⇒ 1.2

**The result of the expression is 1.2.**

questions.question: The radius of the base and height of a solid right circular cylinder are in the ratio 7 ∶ 3 and its volume is 12474 cm³. What is the total surface area of the cylinder? (Use π = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the base and height of the cylinder are in the ratio 7 : 3.

Volume of the cylinder = 12474 cm³

Use π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Total surface area of the cylinder = 2πr(r + h)

Volume of the cylinder = πr²h

**Calculation:**

Let the radius of the base be 7x and the height be 3x.

Volume of the cylinder = πr²h

⇒ (22/7) × (7x)² × (3x) = 12474

⇒ (22/7) × 49x² × 3x = 12474

⇒ (22/7) × 147x³ = 12474

⇒ 22 × 21x³ = 12474

⇒ 462x³ = 12474

⇒ x³ = 27

⇒ x = 3

So, the radius of the base = 7x = 7 × 3 = 21 cm

Height of the cylinder = 3x = 3 × 3 = 9 cm

Total surface area of the cylinder = 2πr(r + h)

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × 21 × (21 + 9)

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × 21 × 30

⇒ 2 × 22 × 3 × 30

⇒ 2 × 22 × 90

⇒ 3960 cm²

**The total surface area of the cylinder is 3960 cm².**

questions.question: Ram received an annual salary of ₹48,580 in the year 2008. This was 25% more than his salary in 2007. What was his salary in 2007?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Annual salary in 2008 = ₹48,580

This was 25% more than his salary in 2007.

**Formula Used:**

If the salary in 2007 is X, then:

2008 Salary = 2007 Salary + 25% of 2007 Salary

₹48,580 = ₹X + 0.25 × ₹X

**Calculations:**

₹48,580 = ₹X + 0.25 × ₹X

₹48,580 = ₹X(1 + 0.25)

₹48,580 = ₹X × 1.25

→ ₹X = ₹48,580 / 1.25

→ ₹X = ₹38,864

**∴ Ram's salary in 2007 was ₹38,864.**

questions.question: The price of an article is reduced by 25% and its daily sale is increased by 30%. The net effect on the daily sale receipts is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Price reduction = 25% = 0.25

Increase in sale = 30% = 0.30

**Formula used:**

Net effect (%) = (x + y + xy/100)%

Where x = -25% (reduction) and y = 30% (increase)

**Calculation:**

Net effect = (-25 + 30 + (-25 × 30)/100)%

⇒ Net effect = (5 - 7.5)%

⇒ Net effect = - 2.5%

**∴ The net effect on the daily sale receipts is a decrease of 2(1)/(2)%.**

questions.question: If a person walked 14 km/h instead of 10 km/h, he would have walked 20 km more. The actual distance travelled by him is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed 1 = 10 km/h

Speed 2 = 14 km/h

Extra distance covered at 14 km/h = 20 km

**Formula used:**

Time is constant, so:

Time = Distance/Speed

Calculation:

Let actual distance = D km

According to the question:

(D/10) = (D + 20)/14

Cross-multiplying:

14 × D = 10 × (D + 20)

14D = 10D + 200

14D - 10D = 200

4D = 200

D = 200/4

D = 50 km

**∴ The actual distance travelled by him is 50 km.**

questions.question: Find the average of 72, 81, 90, 68, 61.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The numbers are 72, 81, 90, 68, 61.

**Formula Used:**

Average = (Sum of all numbers) / (Total count of numbers)

**Calculation:**

Sum of all numbers = 72 + 81 + 90 + 68 + 61

Sum = 372

Total count of numbers = 5

Average = Sum / Total count

Average = 372 / 5

**∴ Average = 74.4**

questions.question: Four years ago, the population of a city was 10,000. The annual growth rate of the population during the first two years was 20%. In the third and fourth years, there was a decrease in the population at the rate of 10% and 5%, respectively. What is the current population of the city after four years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Population 4 years ago = 10,000

Annual growth rate for the first 2 years = 20%

Decrease rate in the third year = 10%

Decrease rate in the fourth year = 5%

**Formula Used:**

Population after n years = Initial Population × (1 + growth rate/100)ⁿumber of years

**Calculation:**

Population after first year = 10,000 × (1 + 20/100)

⇒ Population after first year = 10,000 × 1.2

⇒ Population after first year = 12,000

Population after second year = 12,000 × (1 + 20/100)

⇒ Population after second year = 12,000 × 1.2

⇒ Population after second year = 14,400

Population after third year = 14,400 × (1 - 10/100)

⇒ Population after third year = 14,400 × 0.9

⇒ Population after third year = 12,960

Population after fourth year = 12,960 × (1 - 5/100)

⇒ Population after fourth year = 12,960 × 0.95

⇒ Population after fourth year = 12,312

**The current population of the city after four years is 12,312.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** Population after fourth year = 10,000 × (1 + 20/100) × (1 + 20/100) × (1 - 10/100) × (1 - 5/100)

⇒ 10,000 × 1.2 × 1.2 × 0.9 × 0.95

⇒ 12,312

questions.question: 8 men can complete a work in 6 hours. In how many hours can 12 men complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

8 men can complete a work in 6 hours.

**Formula Used:**

Work = Men × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be W.

Work done by 8 men in 6 hours:

W = 8 × 6

Work done by 12 men in t hours:

W = 12 × t

Since the work is the same:

8 × 6 = 12 × t

⇒ t = (8 × 6) / 12

⇒ t = 48 / 12

⇒ t = 4

**12 men can complete the same work in 4 hours.**

questions.question: The market price of a toy is 25% above the cost price. If the shopkeeper gives 12% discount, then find the gain in the deal.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Market Price (MP) = 25% above Cost Price (CP)

Discount = 12%

**Formula used:**

Gain % = [(SP - CP) / CP] × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the Cost Price be ₹100.

Market Price = CP + 25% of CP = 1.25 × CP

Market Price = 1.25 × 100 = ₹125

Selling Price (SP) = MP - 12% of MP = MP × 0.88

Selling Price = 0.88 × 125 = ₹110

Gain = SP - CP = 110 - 100 = ₹10

Gain % = (10/100) × 100 = 10%

**∴ The gain in the deal is 10%.**

questions.question: What is the difference between the total surface area and the curved surface area of a hemisphere (in cm²) when the radius is 21 cm? (Takе π = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The difference between the **Total Surface Area** (3πr²) and the **Curved Surface Area** (2πr²) of a hemisphere is simply the area of its **circular base** (πr²).

Difference = Area of base = πr²

Difference = (22/7) × 21 × 21 = 22 × 3 × 21

Difference = 66 × 21 = 1386 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1386 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the hemisphere (r) = 21 cm

Value of π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of hemisphere = 2πr²

Total Surface Area (TSA) of hemisphere = 3πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c264313be857bd4680172ae15e52e9deadc8854f5b52016a454604302554766.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 × (22/7) × 21 × 21

⇒ CSA = 2 × 22 × 3 × 21 = 2772 cm²

⇒ Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3 × (22/7) × 21 × 21

⇒ TSA = 3 × 22 × 3 × 21 = 4158 cm²

⇒ Difference = TSA − CSA

⇒ Difference = 4158 − 2772 = 1386 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1386 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of a Sphere

A sphere has only one surface area, which is 4πr². A hemisphere is half of a sphere but adds a flat circular base.

Volume of a Hemisphere

The volume of a hemisphere is exactly half the volume of a sphere: V = (2/3)πr³.

Base Area Relationship

The TSA of a hemisphere is always 1.5 times its CSA because 3πr² = 1.5 × (2πr²).</p

questions.question: What is the difference between the smallest and the largest prime numbers between 1 to 100?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Smallest prime number between 1 and 100 = 2

Largest prime number between 1 and 100 = 97

**Formula Used:**

Difference = Largest prime number - Smallest prime number

**Calculation:**

Smallest prime number = 2

Largest prime number = 97

Difference = 97 - 2

**∴ The difference between the smallest and the largest prime numbers between 1 to 100 is 95.**
